headline: BP Q3 Underlying Profit Rises to $8.46 Billion on Refining Margins
summary: BP reported a third-quarter underlying replacement cost profit of $8.46 billion, beating expectations on the back of strong refining margins.
why: BP is one of the world's major international integrated energy companies, and its quarterly earnings offer insight into global petroleum demand and refining economics.

impacts.name: BP plc
impacts.why: Beating profit expectations with strong refining margins increases cash flow generation and shareholder return prospects.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger-than-anticipated earnings reports from major oil producers exceed consensus estimates, driving positive revisions.
